Executive Summary

Default template

Bushy Tails Ltd recorded total greenhouse gas emissions of 13,156.0 tCO₂e for the 2025–2026 reporting year, comprising 5,420.0 tCO₂e from Scope 1, 2,480.0 tCO₂e from Scope 2 and 5,256.0 tCO₂e from Scope 3, prepared under the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard on an operational control boundary.

Net Zero Commitment

  • Report total greenhouse gas emissions at least annually.

Glossary

TermDefinition
Baseline yearThe reference year against which emissions reductions are measured.
Emission factorA coefficient that converts activity data into GHG emissions.
GHG ProtocolThe globally recognised framework for measuring and managing greenhouse gas emissions.
Intensity metricEmissions normalised by business activity (per employee, per £ revenue, per tonne of product).
Net zeroA balance between greenhouse gas emissions produced and removed from the atmosphere.
Scope 1 / 2 / 3Direct emissions / purchased energy / all other value-chain emissions.
tCO₂eTonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent — the standard unit for measuring carbon emissions.
